summary: Module 5: Production-grade FastAPI inference server. Three REST routes: GET /api/v1/forecast/grid (72h compressed GeoJSON grid), GET /api/v1/forecast/station/{station_id} (time-series vector), GET /api/v1/alerts/inversion (active ISI zones). Integrates mock dataset generation for immediate jury-demo execution. Uses orjson for fast serialisation, Redis cache with TTL=900s, background model inference via asyncio thread pool, and gzip response compression.
